newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia allows St Petersburg 3.0 trln rbl '97 munis.
newsitem.headline: Russia allows St Petersburg 3.0 trln rbl '97 munis.

text.p: The Russian finance ministry has approved issues of three trillion roubles in municipal bonds (MKOs) in 1997 by the City of St Petersburg, the general sales agent for the bonds said on Monday.
A spokesman for AVK, the agent, said the ministry had approved the request on December 26.

The city government had approved the three trillion rouble issue as an interim measure on December 17 while a draft budget, which foresees a total 7.8 trillion roubles in municipal bond issues in the year, is being debated.
